sources.title: DeBiasMe: De-biasing Human-AI Interactions with Metacognitive AIED (AI in Education) Interventions
sources.summary: While generative artificial intelligence (Gen AI) increasingly transforms academic environments, a critical gap exists in understanding and mitigating human biases in AI interactions, such as anchoring and confirmation bias. sources.title: The Green and the Blue
sources.summary: How can Europe benefit politically and socially from the possibilities of digitization and overcome its crises, which have plagued it so much in recent times? sources.title: An Outlook into the Future of Egocentric Vision
sources.summary: What will the future be? We wonder! In this survey, we explore the gap between current research in egocentric vision and the ever-anticipated future, where wearable computing, with outward facing cameras and digital overlays, is expected to be integrated in our every day lives.
